says: In next/, the frame law '0140 frame: only a reserved answer tags the enclosing frame for counting instead of saving' draws its answers from a fixed list (reserved, bad_input, ok), so no plain test holds that a quota refusal tags the connection.frame span, the line transport/Connection.ts:233 now carries. Only the door law in runtime-recovery.laws.integration.test.ts holds it, and that file runs only in a cloud box or CI's full run.
proof: Scratch worktree at d1ccceee9 with quota taken out of transport/Connection.ts:233: transport/Connection.test.ts 'Tests 6 passed (6)', cloudflare/connection.test.ts 'Tests 11 passed (11)', runtime/Gateway.laws.test.ts 'Tests 10 passed (10)'. The law's title also says 'only a reserved answer', while Connection.ts:233 tags reserved, rate_limited and quota.
cost: A change that drops the quota tag from the frame span passes every laptop test and is caught only by the integration run, so 0143's no-row bound for quota refusals is guarded late.
